title: EVC — Evidence-based Vendor Consistency (policy v1)
description: Explainable 0-100 consistency score. Every contribution traces to a stored feature value, a policy weight and source evidence refs. The score is a consistency measure, never a fraud probability (R2): it is composed ONLY of confirmed discrepancies; insufficient evidence contributes zero and is reported as uncertainty instead. Machine-enforced floors below are cross-checked by the loader and may not be weakened by editing this file.

critical_rule.description: risk_level becomes critical (R6 auto-case) when at least this many DISTINCT high-severity confirmed discrepancies exist on one assessment.

duplicate_detection.description: Axes: (1) exact content via the per-org SHA-256 document dedup (two invoice rows bound to the same document row = same bytes billed twice); (2) normalized invoice numbers (retrieval normalize_identifier: INV-2024/007 == inv 2024 007); (3) vendor entity match via the retrieval resolution module when numbers collide across different vendor records; (4) amount+currency and date comparison; (5) near-duplicate field overlap. A same-number pair whose amount differs AND whose date is strictly newer is classified 'corrected_version_candidate' (low) — a genuine corrected re-issue is still human-confirmed, but is not scored like a duplicate upload.

history.description: Fewer than min_invoices comparable prior invoices = insufficient_evidence (absence of history is not fraud, R4).

signals.forcing_note: §8 forcing rules: these signal types force invoices.status = needs_review. missing_evidence / unverified_input / field_provenance_conflict are INFORMATIONAL (no forcing — 'humans decide whether to look' / 'column wins'); a medium signal forces review only when its type forces, while ANY high+ severity is material by itself.

bank_account_consistency.verified_agreement: The printed remittance fingerprint matches an APPROVED bank account (independently verified by a human, R5).
bank_account_consistency.confirmed_discrepancy: The printed remittance details match no APPROVED account — the payment destination is unverified (override: mandatory review).
bank_account_consistency.insufficient_evidence: No printed pay-to details on the invoice — the destination simply cannot be compared.

identity_consistency.verified_agreement: Gate-passed document identity fields agree with the vendor registry.
identity_consistency.confirmed_discrepancy: The vendor is blocked in the registry, or gate-passed identity fields disagree with the registry record.
identity_consistency.insufficient_evidence: The vendor is unresolved, or the document carries no gate-passed identity fields to compare — identity is unknown, never guessed.

duplicate_indicators.verified_agreement: No duplicate indicator fired across any axis.
duplicate_indicators.confirmed_discrepancy: A duplicate/near-duplicate/field-overlap candidate exists — a human dispositions it via the evidence match.
duplicate_indicators.insufficient_evidence: Never used: a duplicate scan always runs; an empty result is verified_agreement.

po_mismatch.verified_agreement: Invoice total equals the linked PO amount (and currencies agree).
po_mismatch.confirmed_discrepancy: Invoice total differs from the PO amount, or the currencies differ.
po_mismatch.insufficient_evidence: No PO is linked, or the PO carries no amount — the record may simply not exist in VeriPay (R4).

historical_anomalies.verified_agreement: The amount is consistent with the vendor's comparable history.
historical_anomalies.confirmed_discrepancy: The amount exceeds the history jump factor times the vendor's median historical amount.
historical_anomalies.insufficient_evidence: Fewer than the minimum comparable prior invoices — no trusted history to compare against.

untrusted_source_indicators.verified_agreement: All machine-extracted inputs used are gate-passed and agree with the invoice columns.
untrusted_source_indicators.confirmed_discrepancy: An invoice column disagrees with its gate-passed extracted provenance.
untrusted_source_indicators.insufficient_evidence: Below-gate extracted values were excluded from evidence (R3) — the affected comparisons are uncertain, not discrepant.

explainability.note: Document-appearance similarity (near-duplicate detection) is a duplicate indicator ONLY. It never contributes to any 'agreement' or authenticity conclusion — feature state verified_agreement means confirmed consistency of facts, never genuineness (R2).
